info.name: Construction Panel — Mr Storage Backend
info.description:
Complete Construction Panel API collection (Oct 2026).

**Base URL variable:** `baseUrl` = `https://mr-storage-backend-025k.onrender.com/api` (or `http://localhost:3000/api`)

**Auth:** Run **Login** first; token is saved to `{{token}}`.

**Roles:** `construction` | `admin`

Each request includes query param descriptions and example JSON responses where applicable. Excel/PDF endpoints return binary — use Send and Download in Postman.

request.description: Returns accessToken in data.accessToken. Use role construction or admin.
KPIs: projectStats, deliveryOverview, taskOverview, upcomingDeadlines, recentDeliveries.
